consequence.statement: Deployability via ko is an additional deployment option for Crossplane; the evidence states no failure, rejection, ignored setting, lost permission or required migration, so an operator who does nothing experiences no operational change.

assertion.statement: Crossplane 2.0.0 adds the ability to deploy Crossplane via ko.

proposal.undeterminedReason: applicability: The note only states that Crossplane can now be deployed via ko; it names no setting, value, field or version condition, and whether an environment uses ko to deploy Crossplane is a deployment-tool choice not expressed in any of the product's configuration inputs, so no exposure predicate can be written from the evidence.
